items.quote: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
items.claim: According to the text (verse 8:20), a ram was cut into pieces and Moses burnt its head, the pieces, and the fat.
items.object: the ram's head, pieces, and fat
items.mechanism: The ram was cut into pieces, then burnt. The text calls the one who cut it only 'he', so it does not name that person.
